records.boundary: The source market has exactly one deterministic positive unit share of its local wet-scrubber producer, with no freight, direct biosphere exchange or other active input. Both source and native service are per kg of retained SOx, with a documented 90% desulfurisation rate and the same burden allocation excluding gypsum as a coproduct. Flatten the unit wrapper only; add no removal-efficiency, oxide-to-sulfur or gypsum-credit factor and preserve separately listed plant emissions.
